films.desc_en: A poetic visual journey through the sunlit apple orchards of the Prespa region, celebrating nature's bounty.
films.music: Soft acoustic guitar, sweeping strings, slow emotional tempo, 65 bpm

shots.kf: Wide shot of a lush apple orchard near Resen at sunrise. Mist gently blankets the green valley floor. Golden morning light illuminates the dew-covered grass. Shot on a 35mm lens, atmospheric composition. Colour palette features warm golds, deep greens, and soft blues. Photorealistic, highly detailed cinematic landscape.
shots.motion: Slow pan to the right. The morning mist rolls gently across the valley floor while the apple trees sway slightly in the breeze.

shots.kf: Extreme close-up of a single, perfectly ripe red apple hanging from a thick branch. The background is a soft, beautifully blurred bokeh of green leaves. Natural sunlight catches the smooth skin of the fruit. Shot with a 85mm macro lens. Rich crimson and vibrant green colour palette. Photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow push-in camera movement towards the apple. A gentle breeze causes the background leaves to flutter softly, shifting the dappled sunlight.

shots.kf: A rustic wooden crate overflowing with freshly harvested red apples rests on the grassy orchard floor. Sunbeams filter through the canopy above, spotlighting the crate. Low angle composition, 50mm lens. The colour palette contrasts the warm earthy browns and vivid reds against the bright green grass. Photorealistic.
shots.motion: Static camera. The sunlight slowly creeps across the surface of the apples, creating a dynamic change in shadows and highlights.

shots.kf: A solitary, unidentifiable farmer in a wide-brimmed hat walks slowly down a long, perfectly aligned row of apple trees. The figure is captured from behind as a dark silhouette against the glowing afternoon sun. Shot with a 50mm lens. Golden hour lighting, warm amber and dark shadow palette. Photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow tracking shot following the farmer from behind. The farmer walks at a steady, relaxed pace while the tree branches sway softly.

shots.kf: Looking up into the canopy of an ancient apple tree. Thick, twisting wooden branches are covered in dense green foliage. Brilliant sun flares pierce through the gaps in the leaves, creating a dreamy, ethereal atmosphere. Wide angle 24mm lens. Luminous greens, bright yellow sunlight, photorealistic and highly detailed.
shots.motion: Slow rotational camera move pointing upwards. The leaves rustle gently in the wind, causing the sun flares to dance across the lens.

shots.kf: Epic wide aerial view of the Resen apple orchards stretching towards the calm blue waters of Lake Prespa in the distance. The sun is setting, casting long dramatic shadows. Shot with a drone camera, 16mm lens. Majestic landscape composition. Vibrant orange, deep green, and cool blue palette. Photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow forward drone flight gliding smoothly over the treetops. The water of the distant lake ripples softly under the setting sun.

films.desc_en: An exploration of modern, climate-controlled greenhouses in Strumica maximizing vegetable yield through technology.
films.music: Modern electronic ambient, rhythmic pulses, precise and clean, 110 bpm
vo_mk: Новата технологија го менува струмичкото земјоделство.
Паметните оранжерии создаваат совршена клима за раст.
Сензорите ја следат влажноста и светлината постојано.
Така добиваме свежи зеленчуци во секое време.
Повеќе принос со помалку потрошена вода.

shots.kf: Aerial wide shot of massive, modern glass greenhouses situated in the flat Strumica valley. The sleek glass structures reflect the bright blue sky and fluffy white clouds. Industrial and clean composition, shot with a 24mm drone lens. Colour palette is dominated by cyan, white, and geometric silver lines. Photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow lateral tracking shot over the greenhouse roofs. The clouds above drift slowly, changing the reflections on the glass panels.

shots.kf: Wide interior shot of a high-tech greenhouse. Endless symmetrical rows of tall hydroponic tomato vines stretch towards the vanishing point. The floor is pristine concrete. Diffused, even natural light pours through the glass ceiling. Shot with a 35mm lens. Vibrant green, clean white, and metallic grey palette. Photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow, smooth forward dolly shot moving straight down the center aisle. The large green leaves of the vines tremble slightly in the ventilation breeze.

shots.kf: Extreme macro shot of a modern irrigation tube dripping water onto the base of a thick, green plant stem. The soil substitute looks dark and rich. Soft, focused artificial lighting highlights the sparkling water droplet. 100mm macro lens. Earthy dark browns and vivid neon greens palette. Photorealistic.
shots.motion: Static camera. A single drop of water slowly forms at the tip of the irrigation nozzle and falls cleanly onto the root base.

shots.kf: Close-up of a cluster of flawless, bright red Strumica tomatoes hanging from a thick green vine. The skin of the tomatoes is smooth and glossy. Soft, diffused greenhouse light wraps around the fruit. 85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field. Dominant deep reds and bright greens. Photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow camera orbit around the tomato cluster. The vine sways very subtly, catching the soft light on the curved surface of the fruit.

shots.kf: Medium shot of an automated, metallic climate control vent on the greenhouse ceiling. The industrial metal contrasts with the blue sky visible through the open glass. Clean, functional composition. Shot with a 50mm lens, sharp focus. Silver, sky blue, and crisp white colour palette. Highly detailed, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The camera remains stationary. The metallic vent mechanism slowly and smoothly glides open, revealing more of the bright blue sky above.

shots.kf: Medium close-up of tiny, delicate green vegetable seedlings growing in perfectly aligned plastic trays. Intense, futuristic purple and pink LED grow lights illuminate the young plants from above. Shot with a 50mm lens, slightly angled downward. Striking neon magenta, deep purple, and bright green palette. Photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow push-in camera move towards the seedlings. The young plants vibrate gently as the automated ventilation system blows a soft breeze across them.

shots.kf: Symmetrical wide interior of the greenhouse at dusk. The long aisles are illuminated by warm, artificial yellow lights, creating a cozy yet highly industrial atmosphere. The glass walls reflect the glowing interior against the darkening exterior. 24mm wide lens. Warm gold, deep blue, and lush green palette. Photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow upward pedestal camera move. The warm artificial lights flicker faintly, casting long, shifting shadows down the infinite rows of vegetation.

films.desc_en: A high-energy, visually striking vertical promo highlighting the iconic tobacco harvest in North Macedonia.
films.music: Upbeat percussion, ethnic drum beats, fast driving energy, 130 bpm

shots.kf: Extreme macro shot, vertical portrait composition. A single, massive green tobacco leaf fills the entire frame. The intricate veins and rough texture of the leaf are incredibly detailed. Dramatic, moody side lighting highlights the ridges. Shot with a 100mm macro lens. Rich emerald green and deep shadow palette. Photorealistic.
shots.motion: Fast upward tilt along the central vein of the tobacco leaf. The leaf flutters slightly as if hit by a sudden, sharp gust of wind.

shots.kf: Vertical portrait composition. Hundreds of yellowing, harvested tobacco leaves are strung on long cords, hanging to dry under a rustic wooden barn roof. The golden hour sun aggressively pierces through the hanging leaves, creating high contrast. Shot with a 35mm lens. Warm amber, gold, and dark brown palette. Photorealistic.
shots.motion: Smooth, continuous downward camera pan revealing the vertical strings of tobacco. The hanging leaves sway gently back and forth in the warm evening air.

shots.kf: Vertical portrait composition. A lone, anonymous farmer wearing a traditional flat cap stands in a dusty field, holding a thick bundle of dried tobacco leaves. Captured as a dark, dramatic silhouette against a blazing, fiery sunset sky. 50mm lens, heroic low angle. Intense orange, crimson, and pitch-black palette. Photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow push-in camera move towards the silhouetted figure. The farmer's clothing and the bundle of tobacco leaves ripple dramatically in the strong wind.

films.desc_en: A cinematic commercial following a modern agronomist in the Pelagonia valley, showcasing the blend of nature and advanced farming machinery.
films.music: Uplifting cinematic acoustic guitar and strings 110 bpm
vo_mk: Утрото во Пелагонија носи нови предизвици.
Земјата бара наша посветеност и труд.
Со модерна технологија, работата станува полесна.
Резултатот е секогаш богат и златен.

shots.kf: Cinematic wide shot of a male agronomist, mid-30s, short beard, wearing a flat cap and dark blue denim jacket, standing in a vast ploughed field in the Pelagonia valley. Early morning mist, warm sunrise lighting casting long shadows. Shot on 35mm lens, photorealistic, rich earth tones.
shots.motion: Slow drone camera pushes forward toward the agronomist. The mist gently rolls across the ploughed earth while the man stands perfectly still.

shots.kf: Low angle macro shot of dry, cracked rich brown soil with small, vibrant green wheat sprouts pushing through the earth. Soft morning sunlight beautifully highlights the rough texture of the dirt. Shallow depth of field, warm earthy color palette, highly detailed, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The camera slowly pans right along the ground. The bright green sprouts sway very slightly in a gentle morning breeze.

shots.kf: A sleek, generic modern green tractor moving through a lush, bright green wheat field. In the foreground, the male agronomist, mid-30s, short beard, flat cap, dark blue denim jacket, watches it pass. Clear blue sky, midday sun, sharp focus, vibrant greens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow camera tracking shot moving left to right, following the slow-moving tractor in the background while the agronomist turns his head slightly.

shots.kf: Close-up of tall, golden wheat stalks ready for harvest, catching the warm, golden hour sunlight. The background is a beautifully blurred landscape of rolling hills. Rich amber and gold color palette, cinematic lighting, 85mm lens, highly detailed, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The camera slowly tilts up. The heavy golden wheat stalks sway smoothly and rhythmically in the gentle evening wind.

shots.kf: Medium portrait of the male agronomist, mid-30s, short beard, flat cap, dark blue denim jacket, standing in the golden wheat field. He looks off-camera towards the horizon with a subtle, proud smile. Warm, cinematic golden hour lighting, soft bokeh background, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow camera push-in on the agronomist's face. The wind gently rustles his denim jacket and the wheat in the background.

films.desc_en: A grounded, non-stock Tikvesh vineyard story: one recurring female viticulturist shows a simple, tactile process—check ripeness, pick, taste—captured in warm late-afternoon light with consistent wardrobe and a clear through-line. No signage, no generic cutaways, all action is hers and connected.
films.music: Warm Balkan acoustic strings with soft frame drum, 92 bpm, intimate and earthy
vo_mk: Во Тиквеш, денот зрее со лозјето.
Една бобинка — вкусот ја кажува вистината.
Кога е совршено, внимателно го собирам.

shots.kf: Photorealistic wide establishing shot in a real Tikvesh vineyard, late afternoon golden light. One female viticulturist (late 40s, dark hair in low bun, white linen shirt, dark green apron, tan trousers) walks between vine rows holding a small wicker basket. Dry soil, low hills in background, natural Balkan landscape, warm greens and ochres, 35mm lens, no readable text or logos.
shots.motion: She walks toward camera, brushing vine leaves lightly with her fingertips. Camera tracks backward smoothly on a gimbal at walking pace, keeping her centered as sunlight flares softly through leaves.

shots.kf: Photorealistic medium close-up at vine level in the same Tikvesh row. The same woman, same outfit, pauses and lifts one grape cluster with her left hand while her right hand gently separates leaves to reveal the fruit. Shallow depth of field, 50mm lens, warm backlight, dust motes in air, palette of deep greens and sunlit golds, no signs or text.
shots.motion: She rotates the cluster slowly to inspect ripeness. Camera makes a small, deliberate push-in of about 20 cm, maintaining focus on her hands and the grapes while background vines fall into creamy bokeh.

shots.kf: Photorealistic tight close-up on hands and fruit: same woman pinches a single grape off the cluster with clean, unambiguous fingers; her simple wedding band visible, no brand marks. The grape skin is slightly translucent in sun. 85mm macro look, soft golden rim light, earthy tones, vine leaves framing the edges, no readable elements anywhere.
shots.motion: She plucks one grape and brings it to her lips, then bites once. Camera pans subtly upward from her hands to her mouth in one continuous move, staying steady and realistic within 5 seconds.

shots.kf: Photorealistic medium shot in the same vine row: the woman decisively harvests the selected cluster and places it into the same wicker basket. The basket already holds a few clusters of identical variety, reinforcing continuity. 35mm lens, warm low sun, gentle contrast, natural skin tones, Balkan vineyard realism, no signage or logos.
shots.motion: She cuts and lowers the cluster into the basket in one clean action. Camera performs a slow left-to-right slide about half a meter, revealing the basket filling as leaves pass softly in the foreground.

shots.kf: Photorealistic medium portrait at the end of the same vineyard row, identical wardrobe and basket. The woman holds the basket at waist height, looking down with a small satisfied smile, then glances toward the vines. Golden hour glow, 50mm lens, soft background hills, warm greens and amber palette, no readable text or branding, clean simple face and hands.
shots.motion: She lifts the basket slightly as if feeling its weight, then stills. Camera makes a gentle push-in and settles, ending on her calm expression and the harvested grapes in frame.
